# gcore_cloud_gpu_baremetal_cluster_flavors (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_gpu_baremetal_cluster_flavors" "example_cloud_gpu_baremetal_cluster_flavors" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `hide_disabled` (Boolean) Set to `true` to remove the disabled flavors from the response.
- `include_prices` (Boolean) Set to `true` if the response should include flavor prices.
- `max_items` (Number) Max items to fetch, default: 1000
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The items returned by the data source (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `architecture` (String) Flavor architecture type
- `capacity` (Number) Number of available instances of given flavor for the client
- `disabled` (Boolean) If the flavor is disabled, new resources cannot be created using this flavor.
- `hardware_description` (Attributes) Additional bare metal hardware description (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--hardware_description))
- `hardware_properties` (Attributes) Additional bare metal hardware properties (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--hardware_properties))
- `name` (String) Flavor name
- `price` (Attributes) Flavor price (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--price))
- `reserved_capacity` (Number) Number of available instances of given flavor from reservations
- `supported_features` (Attributes) Set of enabled features based on the flavor's type and configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--supported_features))

<a id="nestedatt--items--hardware_description"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.hardware_description`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String) Human-readable CPU description
- `disk` (String) Human-readable disk description
- `gpu` (String) Human-readable GPU description
- `network` (String) Human-readable NIC description
- `ram` (String) Human-readable RAM description


<a id="nestedatt--items--hardware_properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.hardware_properties`

Read-Only:

- `gpu_count` (Number) The total count of available GPUs.
- `gpu_manufacturer` (String) The manufacturer of the graphics processing GPU
- `gpu_model` (String) GPU model
- `nic_eth` (String) The configuration of the Ethernet ports
- `nic_ib` (String) The configuration of the InfiniBand ports


<a id="nestedatt--items--price"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.price`

Read-Only:

- `currency_code` (String) Currency code. Shown if the `include_prices` query parameter if set to true
- `price_per_hour` (Number) Price per hour. Shown if the `include_prices` query parameter if set to true
- `price_per_month` (Number) Price per month. Shown if the `include_prices` query parameter if set to true
- `price_status` (String) Price status for the UI
Available values: "error", "hide", "show".


<a id="nestedatt--items--supported_features"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.supported_features`

Read-Only:

- `security_groups` (Boolean)
